title: Jobs And Chips Test Nifty Open
archiveSummary: Jobs And Chips: US jobs data and semiconductor earnings will test whether last week's risk-on momentum can carry into India
deskNote: Jobs And Chips are today's first filter because US jobs data and semiconductor earnings will test whether last week's risk-on momentum can carry into India. Track Nasdaq futures against 23,997.55; sentiment at -0.11 says the first range must prove direction. Tech breadth confirms the headline only if jobs data, chip earnings and US momentum can decide whether global risk appetite survives the open. Let the first 15 minutes print, then trade only the side that holds VWAP with breadth behind it.
watchItems: US jobs-week positioning and Nasdaq futures before India opens; a weak risk tape keeps Nifty in confirmation mode.
Nasdaq and semiconductor futures into the cash open; use them as risk-appetite context, not an automatic Nifty IT call.
Brent reaction to OPEC supply headlines before Europe opens; aviation, OMCs, paints and upstream energy are the first India checks.
